title: The Amazing Spider-Man
tagline: The Webb film’s Lizard story, plus a city to cross.
summary: Beenox’s tie-in continues from Marc Webb’s film and sends Andrew Garfield’s Peter after Curt Connors. The home versions add an open Manhattan the movie does not have. It is still a film adaptation.
gameplay: Open-city web swinging on consoles and PC, with indoor missions and a comic-panel disguise system.
